sens_morris — MULTIVAR sensitivity op

• Data kinds: design × signal → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.sens_morris(design=None, y=None, negligible=0.05) -> 'dict' (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import sensitivity; sensitivity.sens_morris(design=None, y=None, negligible=0.05) -> 'dict', registry से लेना हो तो opsmultivar.get("sens_morris"))

उपयोग

Morris elementary effects -> हर factor के mu, mu*, sigma (Morris 1991; mu* Campolongo et al. 2007)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

design must come from doe_morris (its trajectory bookkeeping is used) and y holds the model output for its rows in order. For trajectory t and step s that moves factor i by ±delta: EE_i = (y_s - y_{s-1}) / (±delta) in unit-cube units, and also per natural unit of the factor (ee_natural; on a log-scale factor the step is in log10 units).

mu (mean EE) can cancel when effects change sign; mu_star (mean |EE|) does not and is the ranking measure; sigma (standard deviation, ddof = 1) is large when the effect depends on where the other factors are (non-linear or interacting). class per factor: negligible (mu* below negligible x the largest mu*), linear/additive (sigma < 0.1 mu*: the effect is the same everywhere — a convention of this op, stated), otherwise non-linear or interacting.
